title: The Sap Camp
journal: The note from the reed hide sent the sap-takers' jars to Karsh-Naal Camp, a Naga camp in the marsh east of Teel-Fen Weir. Someone there is caged at the camp's edge. The key to the cage is on a guard named Jeeta-Sakka, who stands at the fire with the others. I can pick the cage's lock, steal the key from him, or fight the guards. I'm to open the cage; once it is open, Sesk wants her sack from the floor inside handed to her.
objectives: Open the cage at Karsh-Naal Camp and take Sesk's sack from inside (a Novice lock, or the key on Jeeta-Sakka). (marker: Sesk's Cage, Jeeta-Sakka, Sesk's Sack)

plan.going: The sap goes to Karsh-Naal Camp, guarded by Naga. Someone is caged there.
plan.next: Open the cage at the camp's west edge and take Sesk's sack from inside it.
plan.ways: Pick its Novice lock; steal the key from Jeeta-Sakka at the fire; or fight the four guards (or shoot them from the reeds). The guards stay at the fire, so I can sneak to the cage.

answers: I am Tarin, a thief freed by Vosh-Leera of Jal-Veesa. Unbound Sap-Takers are draining the Hist and sealing scars with grey paste; their note sent jars to Karsh-Naal Camp. Someone named Sesk is caged here and wants her sack back.
Open the cage at Karsh-Naal Camp and take Sesk sack from inside, then hand it to her.
Pick the Novice lock, steal the key from guard Jeeta-Sakka, or fight the guards.
I do not know who Sesk is, who the Unbound master is, or what the grey paste is. I could ask Sesk and the guards.

title: The Sap Camp
journal: Sesk drew sap for the Unbound, a cult of the tribeless whose leader is Cuts-the-Old-Knot, an Argonian woman. The sap is for a draught she brews, and the draught has something to do with "the Eye". They call the grey paste in the scars "the seal". Why drain a tree and then seal it, if they only want its sap? I'm to take this to Vosh-Leera in Jal-Veesa.
objectives: Tell Vosh-Leera in Jal-Veesa what Sesk said. (marker: Vosh-Leera)

plan.going: The Unbound, led by Cuts-the-Old-Knot, drain trees for a draught to do with "the Eye", and seal the scars. The question I carry: why seal a tree they only want sap from?
plan.next: Go back to Vosh-Leera in Jal-Veesa and tell her.

answers: I work for Vosh-Leera of Jal-Veesa. The Unbound, a cult of the tribeless led by Cuts-the-Old-Knot, drain Hist sap, seal scars with grey paste called the seal, and send jars to a draught linked to something called the Eye. Sesk, freed, told me this.
Go to Vosh-Leera in Jal-Veesa and tell her.
I could go straight there, or first ask Sesk the other topics about Cuts-the-Old-Knot and the seal.
I do not know what the Eye is, what is in the seal paste, or where Cuts-the-Old-Knot is. I might learn from Sesk, Vosh-Leera, or Heem-Jasa.

title: The Sap Camp
journal: Vosh-Leera says this is more than a herald can judge, and paid me a hundred gold. I'm to go to the order's handler, Nesh-Deeka, at her house in Helstrom. Helstrom is far to the south through deadly country, so I'm to ride the rootworm, which the tree-minder calls at the Hist pool here. First I'm to ask Weeltul about it.
objectives: Ask Weeltul at Jal-Veesa's Hist pool about the rootworm to Helstrom. (marker: Weeltul)

plan.going: I am sent on to the order's handler, Nesh-Deeka, in Helstrom.
plan.next: Ask Weeltul at the Hist pool about the rootworm to Helstrom.
plan.ways: One way; the road on foot runs through deadly country.

answers: Vosh-Leera heard my report and paid 100 gold. She says it is beyond a herald; the order handler Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom should judge it.
Ask Weeltul at the Hist pool in Jal-Veesa about the rootworm to Helstrom (fare 25 gold).
Take the rootworm as told, or look for another road, though it is deadly country.
I do not know Nesh-Deeka beyond her name, the Xeech-Leel council, or what the Eye is. I can ask in Helstrom.

title: The Sap Camp
journal: Weeltul told me how the rootworm works: a great worm that swims the roots between the trees' pools, and she calls it for travellers at Jal-Veesa's pool. The fare to Helstrom is twenty-five gold, paid to her. I'm to pay her the fare, ride to Helstrom and find Nesh-Deeka's House there.

plan.going: I know what the rootworm is, where to take it and what it costs.
plan.next: Pay Weeltul the fare, ride to Helstrom and find Nesh-Deeka's House.

answers: Notes: I am Tarin, a thief working for Vosh-Leera of Jal-Veesa. I picked Sesk cage lock at Karsh-Naal Camp, returned her sack, and she told me the Unbound (tribeless cult led by Cuts-the-Old-Knot, an Argonian woman) drain Hist sap, seal scars with grey paste called the seal, and send jars to a draught for something called the Eye. Vosh-Leera paid me 100 gold (I now have about 150) and says the order handler Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom must judge it.
Next: ask Weeltul at Jal-Veesa pool to call the rootworm, pay 25 gold, ride to Helstrom and find Nesh-Deeka House; the rootworm caller there can point the way.
I carry a lockpick, the Hist blessing, the Unbound note and gold. Heem-Jasa teaches alchemy and sells sap, fungus and eggshells.
Still unknown: what the Eye is, what the seal paste is made of, where Cuts-the-Old-Knot is, and what Umbriel did beyond the 4E 48 story.
